types.description: S201M-C25 miniature circuit breaker / 1 pole / C characteristic / 25 A

document.title: ABB System pro M compact catalogue

modelingNotes: Exact order row identifies S 201 M-C 25, one pole, 25 A, C characteristic.

IEC/EN 60898-1: 1P Un 230/400 V AC, Icn 10 kA, reference temperature 30 degrees C. IEC/EN 60947-2: 1P Ue 230 V AC, Icu 15 kA, Ics 11.2 kA for this 25 A unit, reference temperature 55 degrees C. Frequency 50/60 Hz. No scalar nominal voltage assigned.

Catalogue S201 family diagram shows terminal 1 above terminal 2 and one breaker contact. Terminal roles are bidirectional: supply is optional at either end. Open state represents the drawn OFF state, not an automatic net connection or trip simulation.

Cylinder-lift terminals support conductor and busbar attachment at each numbered electrical point; these are not separately numbered poles. No PE, neutral, coil, communication or auxiliary contacts belong to this bare order. Compatible auxiliary devices are separate accessories.

Contact endpoints remain separate nets; no fixed link. Connections are application-dependent and neither terminal is universally required. Protection coordination and installation suitability are outside this model.

connectionCoverage.notes: Both numbered electrical connection points of the bare one-pole breaker are represented: 1 and 2. Conductor and busbar attachment share their respective numbered terminal. Separately purchased auxiliaries are excluded.

1.description: Main pole terminal 1; supply may enter either end

2.description: Main pole terminal 2; supply may enter either end
